============================================================================== Company: Precision Automation & Robotics India Ltd. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Item Code:SM0101022005 Author/Created by: Amiya Das Reviewed/Checked by: Atul Patwardhan First Release on: 20-01-2017 Latest update on:27-01-2025 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Tested with:Simulator Engineering/Editor: TIA Portal 15 & Higher ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Restrictions: No Dependencies/Requirements: NA ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Change Log: Ver. Date Changed by Details of changes 0.2 20-01-2017 Amiya Das Second release version 0.3 27-01-2025 Sujeet Rote qMsgBothCmdOn message is added 0.4 29-01-2025 Sujeet Rote Work & home position left option bit ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Functionality: This block is used to control a simple motion with one work position output, one home position output, one work position sensor and one home position sensor. Inputs iResetModule Bool iResetFaults Bool iEnergizeAtPwrOn Bool iWorkCmd Bool iHomeCmd Bool iWorkSen Bool iHomeSen Bool iWorkCleartoMove Bool iHomeCleartoMove Bool iWorkPositionLeftOption Bool iHomePositionLeftOption Bool iTimeoutValue Time iWorkSensDebounceVal Time iHomeSensDebounceVal Time
Outputs qWorkSol Bool qHomeSol Bool qWorkOver Bool qHomeOver Bool qErrBothSensorOn Bool qErrHomeInterlock Bool qErrHomeSenNotLeft Bool qErrHomeTout Bool qErrWorkInterlock Bool qErrWorkSenNotLeft Bool qErrWorkTout Bool qMsgWorkPosLost Bool qMsgHomePosLost Bool qMsgBothCmdOn Bool
In-outs NIL ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Errors reported: 1.qErrBothSensorOn: If both WorkSen and HomeSen inputs are high at the same time. 2.qErrHomeInterlock: If homeCleartoMove is low and home command is active. 3.qErrHomeSenNotLeft: If home position sensor did not turn off within defined time 4.qErrHomeTout: If cylinder did not reach home position within defined time 5.qErrWorkInterlock: If WorkCleartoMove is low and work command is active. 7.qErrWorkSenNotLeft: If work position sensor did not turn off within defined time 8.qErrWorkTout: If cylinder did not reach work position within defined time 9.qErrPipeSwaped: If Pipe or sensor swapped
Messages reported: 1.qMsgHomePosLost: If home position achieved and lost its position without work 2.qMsgWorkPosLost: If work position achieved and lost its position without home 3.qMsgBothCmdOn : Home & work position command on same time ==============================================================================
